scope: Context transport and accounting; not a fresh full game generation or game quality evaluation

historical_generation.cause: Each author/reviewer call used a fresh ephemeral CLI session and a complete mutable JSON snapshot; canonical key sorting put source ahead of much of the stable brief.

offline_saved_draft_comparison.limitation: Reconstructed author inputs from saved checkpoint states. Synthetic summary-only assistant replies were used for history sizing. This is neither token usage nor a provider cache-hit measurement; excludes the later confirmation-reference optimization.

live_transport_probe.task: Return the current turn and a changed string marker; no game generation, execution or mutation.
live_transport_probe.scope_note: Measured transport before final source-confirmation and diagnostic refinements. The second-turn 94.0% hit rate is not a forecast of the full-game hit rate.
